examples.zh: 課外社團培養了團隊合作精神與社交技巧。

examples.en: The task was completed in a fraction of the expected time.
examples.zh: 該任務僅用了預計時間的一小部分便完成了。

examples.en: Stress caused a visible fracture in the structural beam.
examples.zh: 受壓導致建築結構橫樑出現肉眼可見的裂痕。

examples.en: Handle this package carefully because contents are fragile.
examples.zh: 小心搬運此包裹，因為內裝物品易碎。

examples.en: Researchers assembled fragments of the ancient papyrus scroll.
examples.zh: 研究人員拼合了古代莎草紙卷軸的碎片。

examples.en: The bank uses biometric safeguards to prevent identity fraud.
examples.zh: 銀行採用生物辨識防護機制以杜絕身分詐欺。

examples.en: Tires rely on friction to maintain traction on wet roads.
examples.zh: 輪胎依靠摩擦力在濕滑路面上維持抓地力。

examples.en: Quantum computing represents the frontier of modern physics.
examples.zh: 量子運算代表了現代物理學的尖端前沿。

examples.en: Do not let occasional setbacks frustrate your determination.
examples.zh: 切勿讓偶爾的挫折消磨打擊你的決心。

examples.en: He worked diligently to fulfill his lifelong dream.
examples.zh: 他辛勤耕耘以圓滿實現畢生夢想。

examples.en: Honesty is a fundamental virtue in interpersonal relationships.
examples.zh: 誠實是人際互動中最根本的美德。

examples.en: Customers were furious about the unannounced service interruption.
examples.zh: 顧客對未事先公告的無預警停機服務感到極度憤怒。

examples.en: Telescopes capture breathtaking images of the Milky Way galaxy.
examples.zh: 望遠鏡捕捉到了銀河星系令人屏息的壯麗影像。

examples.en: We should not generalize based solely on individual anecdotes.
examples.zh: 我們不應僅憑個別軼事就輕易下概括結論。

examples.en: Wind farms generate sustainable energy for thousands of households.
examples.zh: 風力發電廠為數千戶家庭產生永續潔淨能源。

examples.en: The alumni made a generous gift to fund student scholarships.
examples.zh: 校友捐贈了一筆慷慨的善款資助學生獎學金。

examples.en: Her actions proved she had a genuine desire to assist others.
examples.zh: 她的行動證明了她有真誠助人的願望。

examples.en: The trailer gave fans a tantalizing glimpse of the upcoming film.
examples.zh: 預告片讓影迷隱約搶先一窺即將上映的影片精華。

examples.en: The autumn foliage in the valley looked absolutely gorgeous.
examples.zh: 山谷裡的秋日楓紅景致美得令人驚嘆。

examples.en: Acquiring a foreign language is a gradual learning journey.
examples.zh: 習得一門外語是一個循序漸進的學習歷程。

examples.en: He expressed gratitude to everyone who lent a helping hand.
examples.zh: 他向每一位伸出援手的人表達了深切的感激。

examples.en: Art became a healthy channel to express and comfort his grief.
examples.zh: 藝術成為他抒發並撫平深沉悲痛的健康途徑。

examples.en: Diligent review cannot guarantee perfection, but builds mastery.
examples.zh: 用功複習雖不能保證十全十美，但能奠定扎實實力。

examples.en: The startup adopted a flat structure rather than a rigid hierarchy.
examples.zh: 這家新創公司採取了扁平化組織而非刻板僵化的階層制度。

examples.en: Public outrage flared over the prominent leader's hypocrisy.
examples.zh: 社會大眾對這位知名領袖的偽善行徑感到群情激憤。

examples.en: The professor's lecture helped illuminate complex ethical theories.
examples.zh: 教授的講課有助於清晰闡釋複雜的倫理學理論。

examples.en: No economy is completely immune to global financial volatility.
examples.zh: 沒有任何經濟體能完全免受全球金融波動的影響。

examples.en: The department will implement new guidelines next semester.
examples.zh: 該部門將於下學期實施推行新指引。

examples.en: There was an implicit mutual understanding between the partners.
examples.zh: 合作夥伴之間存在著一種心照不宣的默契。

examples.en: His polite remark did not imply approval of the strategy.
examples.zh: 他客氣的言辭並不意味著贊同這項策略。

examples.en: Regulators decided to impose strict carbon limits on factories.
examples.zh: 監管機構決定對工廠強制實施嚴格的碳排放上限。

examples.en: The error was deemed inadvertent rather than deliberate.
examples.zh: 該錯誤被認定為純屬無心疏忽而非故意為之。

examples.en: The governor will inaugurate the metropolitan transit extension.
examples.zh: 首長將為捷運大眾運輸延伸線主持通車啟用儀式。

examples.en: Tax credits offer a financial incentive to adopt electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 稅負抵減為採用電動車提供了實質的財務誘因。

examples.en: Security teams investigated the minor cyber incident immediately.
examples.zh: 資安團隊立即針對這起輕微的網路安全事件展開調查。

examples.en: She showed an innate inclination towards scientific research.
examples.zh: 她展現出投身科學研發的天生傾向。

examples.en: The new app design will incorporate direct student suggestions.
examples.zh: 嶄新的 App 設計將直接納入學生的反饋建言。

examples.en: Scholars work to record indigenous oral traditions.
examples.zh: 學者們致力於記錄本土原住民族群的口述歷史傳統。

examples.en: Spaced repetition algorithms are indispensable for lasting recall.
examples.zh: 間隔複習演演算法對於建立長久記憶不可或缺。

examples.en: Chronic sleeplessness can induce severe cognitive fatigue.
examples.zh: 長期失眠會誘發嚴重的認知疲憊。

examples.en: Occasional mistakes are an inevitable element of acquiring skills.
examples.zh: 偶爾出錯是各項技能學習歷程中不可避免的環節。

examples.en: Readers can infer the protagonist's motives from subtle clues.
examples.zh: 讀者可以從微妙的線索中推斷出主角的動機。

examples.en: Curiosity unlocks virtually infinite avenues for learning.
examples.zh: 好奇心為求知開闢了幾近無限的廣闊途徑。

examples.en: Central banks adjust interest rates to curb rising inflation.
examples.zh: 中央銀行調控基準利率以抑制日益攀升的通貨膨脹。

examples.en: Verify critical information against reliable academic sources.
examples.zh: 請比照權威學術來源核實關鍵資訊與資料。

examples.en: The engineer devised an ingenious solution using solar sensors.
examples.zh: 工程師運用太陽能感應器構思出一個精巧絕倫的解決方案。

examples.en: There are inherent challenges when learning unfamiliar idioms.
examples.zh: 在學習陌生慣用語的過程中存在著內在固有的挑戰。

examples.en: Future generations inherit the stewardship of our planet.
examples.zh: 下一代子孫將繼承管理我們地球家園的重責大任。

examples.en: The student council voted to initiate a campus recycling drive.
examples.zh: 學生會表決通過發起校園資源回收推廣活動。

definition: 投資；投入；資金投資；投入資本

examples.en: Wise learners invest time into long-term spaced repetition.
examples.zh: 明智的學習者會將時間投入於長期間隔複習。

examples.en: Firms invest capital to upgrade modern cloud infrastructure.
examples.zh: 各企業投入資金升級現代化雲端運算架構。

examples.en: Please verify all charges before settling the supplier invoice.
examples.zh: 在結清廠商發票之前，請逐項核對各項明細費用。

examples.en: The company voted to liquidate non-core real estate holdings.
examples.zh: 公司表決處分變現非核心房地產資產。

examples.en: Optimized logistics reduce international freight transit times.
examples.zh: 最佳化的物流運籌能有效縮短國際貨運週轉時間。

definition: 管理；處置；經營；管理業務

examples.en: She managed to complete the task ahead of time.
examples.zh: 她設法提前完成了這項任務。

examples.en: He manages an international team of talented software engineers.
examples.zh: 他管理著一支由優秀軟體工程師組成的國際團隊。

definition: 市場；推銷；商業市場；推銷行銷

examples.en: The startup aims to capture a share of the global market.
examples.zh: 這家新創公司旨在佔領全球市場的一席之地。

examples.en: They plan to market the mobile software to high school students.
examples.zh: 他們計畫向高中學生行銷推廣這款手機軟體。

examples.en: Management released a company-wide memo regarding guidelines.
examples.zh: 管理團隊發布了一份全公司備忘錄以宣導新指引。

definition: 記憶力；電腦記憶體與記憶容量

examples.en: Spaced retrieval practice strengthens long-term memory recall.
examples.zh: 間隔檢索練習能夠強化大腦長期記憶的提取回想。

examples.en: Antitrust regulations prevent any single firm from holding a monopoly.
examples.zh: 反託拉斯法規防止任何單一廠商形成市場壟斷。

definition: 協商；談判；商務談判；議價

examples.en: Diplomats worked tirelessly to negotiate a peaceful agreement.
examples.zh: 外交官員不分晝夜地努力協商出一項和平協議。

examples.en: Procurement managers negotiate pricing with parts suppliers.
examples.zh: 採購經理正與零組件供貨商就價格進行商務談判議價。

definition: 訂單；秩序；點餐；採購訂單；下單

examples.en: The warehouse processed every customer order promptly.
examples.zh: 倉庫迅速處理了每一筆顧客訂單。

examples.en: The logistics hub processed thousands of online orders today.
examples.zh: 物流中心今天迅速處理了數千筆線上採購訂單。

examples.en: The firm decided to outsource routine accounting tasks.
examples.zh: 該事務所決定將例行日常會計事務委外包辦。

examples.en: The contract stipulates a financial penalty for late delivery.
examples.zh: 合約明確規定延遲交貨將處以違約罰款。

examples.en: Only authorized personnel may enter the server room.
examples.zh: 僅獲授權的人員方可進入伺服器機房。

examples.en: He snapped a high-quality photograph of the city skyline.
examples.zh: 他拍了一張城市天際線的高畫質照片。

examples.en: He snapped a high-quality photograph of the city skyline.
examples.zh: 他拍了一張城市天際線的高畫質照片。

definition: 政策；方針；保險單；公司政策規章

examples.en: The company updated its remote work policy this quarter.
examples.zh: 公司本季更新了遠端工作方針與政策。

examples.en: The human resources policy ensures equitable workplace standards.
examples.zh: 人力資源規章政策確保了公平公正的職場環境標準。

definition: 利潤；獲利；商業營利利潤

examples.en: Sustainable enterprises reinvest a portion of profit into research.
examples.zh: 永續型企業會將部分獲利再投資於研發。

examples.en: Net profit improved steadily following cost-reduction measures.
examples.zh: 在推行降低成本措施之後，淨利潤實現了穩步提升。

examples.en: The engineering team finished the project ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 工程團隊提前完成了該項專案計畫專案。

definition: 推廣；提倡；晉升；晉升職務；促銷商品

examples.en: The initiative aims to promote digital literacy across schools.
examples.zh: 該倡議旨在推廣校園數位素養。

examples.en: The board voted to promote her to senior marketing director.
examples.zh: 董事會表決通過晉升她為資深行銷總監。

definition: 投資說明書；公開招股章程

examples.en: Prospective investors should carefully review the fund prospectus.
examples.zh: 有意願的投資人應當審慎詳閱基金公開說明書。

examples.en: The dedicated sales team reached its quarterly sales quota.
examples.zh: 辛勤的業務團隊達成了該季度的銷售配額目標。

examples.en: Retain your purchase receipt to claim the item warranty.
examples.zh: 請保留您的購買收據，以便享有商品售後保固服務。

examples.en: The bank had to restructure its debt portfolio.
examples.zh: 該銀行不得不針對其債權投資組合進行重組改組。

examples.en: Tailor your professional resume to highlight project experience.
examples.zh: 調整客製化你的履歷表以凸顯專案實務經驗。

examples.en: Annual revenue surged due to robust digital sales growth.
examples.zh: 受惠於強勁的數位銷售成長，年度營業額大幅攀升。

examples.en: We explored scenic trails around the mountain.
examples.zh: 我們探索了環繞著這座山的風景步道。

definition: 行程表；排程；專案時程表；排定會議

examples.en: Please check your schedule to confirm availability.
examples.zh: 請查閱您的行程表以確認是否有空。

examples.en: The team maintained strict adherence to the project schedule.
examples.zh: 團隊嚴格落實並遵循專案時程表進度。

examples.en: Reduce eye strain by taking breaks from your computer screen.
examples.zh: 適度遠離電腦螢幕休息能有效減緩眼睛疲勞。

examples.en: Sign up for the upcoming project management seminar today.
examples.zh: 今天就報名參加即將舉行的專案管理研討會。

examples.en: The cloud server maintains high uptime throughout the year.
examples.zh: 雲端網路伺服器全年維持極高的正常運作率。

examples.en: You can track the real-time status of your overseas shipment.
examples.zh: 你可以即時追蹤海外貨運包裹的最新狀態。

definition: 電腦軟體程式；應用程式

examples.en: Open-source software empowers developers across the globe.
examples.zh: 開源電腦軟體程式為全球工程師賦能。

examples.en: Traders speculate on future foreign currency movements.
examples.zh: 交易員針對未來外匯市場匯率走勢進行推測預估。

definition: 策略；戰略；行銷戰略；企業決策策略

examples.en: Developing a clear strategy is essential for expansion.
examples.zh: 制定清晰明確的策略對業務擴展必不可少。

examples.en: A well-crafted digital strategy boosts overall customer engagement.
examples.zh: 精心規劃的數位策略有助於大幅提升顧客整體的參與度。

examples.en: Authorities will subsidize renewable energy installations.
examples.zh: 主管機關將為再生能源裝置設置提供實質經費補貼。

examples.en: We source eco-friendly packaging from certified suppliers.
examples.zh: 我們向具備認證的合規供應商採購環保包材。

examples.en: Every electronic financial transaction is safeguarded by SSL.
examples.zh: 每一筆電子金融交易均受到加密機制安全防護。

examples.en: The restructuring spurred an impressive financial turnaround.
examples.zh: 組織重組帶動了令人讚嘆的轉虧為盈營運轉機。

examples.en: The IT department posted an urgent job vacancy online.
examples.zh: 資訊技術部門在網路上刊登了緊急職缺招募。

examples.en: The company signed an agreement with an office supply vendor.
examples.zh: 該公司與一家辦公用品供應商簽署了合約協議。

definition: 起伏劇烈的；不穩定易變的

examples.en: Cryptocurrency exchanges are famously volatile markets.
examples.zh: 加密貨幣交易所是公認價格起伏極其劇烈動盪的市場。

examples.en: The monitor comes with a three-year replacement warranty.
examples.zh: 這款螢幕享有三年免費換新保固。

definition: 殖利率；投資收益率；產出

examples.en: Government treasury bonds offer a stable annual yield.
examples.zh: 政府公債提供穩定可靠的年度實質投資收益殖利率。
